feature: P005 local share-channel choice, onShareVisibility with enforceable export-channel restrictions

roam.shareChannels.boundary.en: This only chooses available actions. It does not change another app’s audience settings or recall images already shared.
roam.shareChannels.boundary.zh-Hans: 这里只选择可用操作，不会更改其他 App 的可见范围，也不会撤回已经分享的图片。

roam.shareChannels.hint.allOptions.en: Save the card, follow an album guide, or choose a destination in the system share sheet. Nothing is posted automatically.
roam.shareChannels.hint.allOptions.zh-Hans: 可保存卡片、查看相册分享指引，或在系统分享面板中选择目的地。不会自动发布。

roam.shareChannels.hint.momentsGuide.en: Keep the save action and Moments instructions. Choose who can see your post in WeChat yourself.
roam.shareChannels.hint.momentsGuide.zh-Hans: 保留保存操作和朋友圈指引。请在微信中自行选择谁可见。

roam.shareChannels.hint.saveOnly.en: Only the existing Save to Photos action is available for this card.
roam.shareChannels.hint.saveOnly.zh-Hans: 这张卡片只保留现有的存入相册操作。

mode_mapping.allOptions: Mini public action intent, constrained to existing native save/Moments/Xiaohongshu/system; no Square post
mode_mapping.momentsGuide: Mini friends action subset; save+Moments guide without claiming friend privacy enforcement
mode_mapping.saveOnly: Mini private action subset; save only; no output sent automatically

existing_writers_and_permissions: Unchanged. No Photos permission request/write performed by mode selection. Existing save UI remains user initiated.
image_and_receipt_behavior: Channel change leaves image content and completed save receipt unchanged; only retires album-guide presentation/callbacks, avoiding duplicate saved image. Route/source changes keep existing image invalidation.
Hub: Unchanged; no dependency or reapplication of18–20
acceptance: Ordinary existing Hub->history->record->share->choose each local mode->prepare card; only permitted actions visible
Switch mode after prepare retains same image; no automatic save or share; saved receipt reusable without duplicate write
